action.objective: Verify f4f1 (Rf1), the broad-search top candidate, at full depth 4 with mate safety and tactical refutation checks.
action.rationale: Broad depth-3 search (3000 nodes) ranked f4f1 as the exact top candidate (+100), an upper-bounded tie field otherwise. reserved_verification holds 2000 nodes for f4f1. Need single-candidate verification at depth 4 to confirm no mating reply or tactical refutation before committing. After Nxh1 Black threatens; Rf1 contests the e-file and keeps rook active while king shelters on h4 with pawns h3/g7.
